learning_outcomes.text: Appreciate and use a range of modern manufacturing techniques, including hand tools.
Appreciate the importance of materials selection as a fundamental aspect of the design process.
Understand the importance of team working and cooperative learning while completing complex tasks.
Appreciation of formal design methods and standards, and the use of sketching, 3D solid modelling and drawing as an essential component of communication and product development cycle.
Appreciation of modern CAD-CAM techniques and software.

syllabus_topics: Creation of a remote control (RC) mechanism using a range of manufacturing techniques and development of an appreciation of hand and machine tools for manufacturing and assembly.
Basics of teamwork while creating a remote control (RC) mechanism in the first semester and while re-designing this mechanism in the second semester using computer-aided tools.
Introduction to Engineering Communication, including engineering drawings and their place within the wider context of the manufacturing process.
Development of presentation skills presenting the results of team work on a remote control (RC) mechanism.
Introduction to the Design Process through sketching, 3D solid modelling and assembling using CAD software.
Introduction to CAD-CAM techniques and basic techniques in the use of specialised software.
Basics of engineering report writing while working together on the group coursework report.
assessment_rules: Students must gain a summative mark of 40% to pass the module. Students who fail at the first attempt will be re-assessed prior to the July/August exam diet. This re-assessment will consist entirely of coursework. No marks from any previous attempts will be transferred to a new resit attempt.
